verdict:
KILL, and the triage earned this verdict rather than defaulting to it. It caught two genuine artifacts, then correctly declined to let them rescue the name.

THE TWO ARTIFACTS ARE REAL AND BOTH WERE WORTH FINDING. First, the headline EPS disaster is a denominator artifact. 'Minus $2.37 versus minus $0.15 expected' was struck on 9.1M weighted-average shares because Q2 predates the July 1 close and the filer for the period is Securitize I, Inc., pre-combination. Against the post-merger 163,265,685 shares, the $21.7M net loss is about minus $0.13 per share - essentially in line with the minus $0.15 consensus - and it was further inflated by a $29.3M non-cash fair-value charge on option liabilities. The number that drove a 22% after-hours move was mechanically incomparable to the estimate it was measured against. Second, the screen's market cap is wrong for valuation. The event blob carries $1.13B, a pre-print price. At $5.61 on 163.3M shares the cap is about $916M, and with roughly $350M of net cash and no debt the enterprise value is about $566M - roughly 7.5x EV to guided FY26 sales, or about 9.3x on the fully diluted count the SPAC structure implies. Not the 19x a naive cap-over-revenue screen prints. Both catches are textbook aggregation-artifact discipline and both were run unprompted.

AND YET THE TRIAGE REACHED THE RIGHT ANSWER, WHICH IS THAT NONE OF THAT IS A REASON TO OWN IT. This is the part I want to endorse explicitly, because it is the harder call. The artifact made the FIRST move mispriced. The market then kept selling: two sessions later the stock is $5.61, BELOW the $6.13 after-hours print. The tape did not retrace the artifact, it validated the fundamentals underneath - and those are not artifacts. Revenue of $14.4M was 30% below consensus and DOWN 5% year over year. Tokenization revenue, the leg the story is sold on, fell 12%. Adjusted EBITDA swung $7.3M year over year to minus $5.5M on operating expense up 56% to $24.1M. And management cut the FY26 guide to $70-80M from $85M on the same call. A mispriced first move that the fundamentals subsequently validate is not a dislocation; it is a stock finding the right level by the wrong route.

THE GUIDE IS THE KILL, AND IT IS ARITHMETIC. First-half actual revenue is $33.9M. The cut guide of $70-80M implies a second half of $36.1-46.1M, or $18.1-23.1M per quarter. Against a Q2 that printed $14.4M and DECLINED year over year, that is a step-up of 26% to 60% - and the named driver is an NYSE digital-ATS launch with NO announced date. The entire back half rests on an unlaunched product. That is not a question a court can argue its way through; it is date-locked to roughly November 11.

MANAGEMENT CONCEDED THE BEAR'S MECHANISM IN ITS OWN WORDS, AND THIS IS THE MOST REUSABLE THING IN THE FILE. Average tokenized assets under management grew 16% to $4.3B and volume grew 147% to $5.3B - WHILE REVENUE FELL. Management then stated that 'AUM-based revenue remains immaterial' and that transaction monetization is a 'medium to long term' opportunity. The two metrics the entire equity story is marketed on are, by the company's own account, not the revenue drivers. When the marketed KPI decouples from revenue AND management disavows the link, the KPI is narrative, not a leading indicator. The honest leading indicator here is something else entirely - a count of new protocol and integration announcements per quarter, which is the actual driver management cited for the shortfall ('fewer new on-chain integrations') and which is press-released for free.

THE SUPPLY PICTURE DISQUALIFIES THIS AS A DISLOCATION OUTRIGHT, AND IT IS THE INVERSE OF WHAT WE LOOK FOR. A dislocation needs a forced seller creating a discount unrelated to value. SECZ has the opposite: an S-1 registering 151,568,524 resale shares - 93% of shares outstanding - went effective 2026-08-07, five days before the print. Only about 38.2% of shares are lock-up restricted, for 180 days from the July 1 close, to roughly 2026-12-28, with early release requiring $15.00, $17.50 or $20.00 VWAP triggers that are dead letters at $5.61. So roughly 60% of the register became freely sellable a week before this queue reached it, and the remainder frees up three weeks AFTER Q3 reports. Price is not going to run away from anyone who waits, and the marginal seller is structurally on the other side.

CHEAPNESS IS REAL AND IT IS NOT ENOUGH. About 7.5x EV to guided sales with 38% of the market cap in net cash is genuinely inexpensive. But it is cheapness contingent on a back half that must step up 26-60% off the quarter just printed, delivered by a product with no launch date, into a register where 93% of shares are registered for resale. Nothing about that configuration pays you to be early. FLAT is correct and the triage was right that a court would not have changed it.

ONE PROCESS ITEM THE TRIAGE FLAGGED HONESTLY AND SOMEONE MUST ACTUALLY CLOSE. The triage had no Bash tool and denied reads outside its temp directory, so the standing closing step - ledger upsert, edge classification, entry plan, scanner re-run, /api/everything verification - was NOT executed. The verdict is FLAT with no envelope change so the delta is a triage record only, but SECZ appears nowhere in research_ledger.json today. It needs writing.
blue_ruling: NO COURT - triage-routed straight from REFUTABILITY to ADJUDICATE on a court-worthiness score of 5/10, below the dispatch threshold. The single REFUTABILITY artifact of 2026-08-15 23:01Z is the entire record. It is a strong triage: it argues its own case against escalation, and the argument holds.
reopen_gates: DATA (the binary, and it is clean): Q3 revenue at or above $18.1M - the low end of the cut guide's implied quarterly floor - means the guide is intact and the name is worth re-courting. Below $18.1M is a second consecutive guidance failure and the thesis is dead; move from AVOID to closed.

DATA: tokenization revenue returning to year-over-year growth. This is the single line that decides whether Q2 was launch-timing lumpiness, which is management's explanation ('fewer new on-chain integrations'), or genuine fee erosion. Asset servicing is the stable leg and is not the question.

EVENT: a DATED NYSE digital-ATS launch announcement. It is the only named driver of the entire second-half guide and it currently has no date attached. An undated driver behind a 26-60% step-up is not a plan.

LEADING INDICATOR (free, and it is the honest proxy - explicitly NOT AUM or volume): count new protocol and integration announcements per quarter from the company's own press releases. Management identified integration count as the actual revenue driver and simultaneously disavowed AUM as immaterial.

SUPPLY: the ~2026-12-28 lock-up release on the remaining ~38.2% tranche. Note it lands about three weeks AFTER the Q3 print, so a good Q3 does not clear the supply calendar - the two events must both be passed before any entry.
PROCESS: SECZ is absent from research_ledger.json entirely. Write the triage record on the closing pass; a KILL that leaves no ledger trace will be re-swept by the same screen.
